This is a senior-level backend and machine learning engineering role at The Home Depot, working on product recommendation systems and search relevance. The work spans building microservices and distributed backend systems alongside ML model development, training, and deployment, with some mentoring of junior engineers. The core stack is Java, Scala, or Python on Google Cloud Platform — GKE, Cloud Run, BigQuery, Dataflow/Apache Beam, Spark, Airflow, and Vertex AI — with TensorFlow, PyTorch, and scikit-learn for modeling, plus generative AI work using Gemini, RAG, and vector search.
